opportunity.name: FAI Frontier Legal Defense
fitAxes: new generation of lawyers and legal scholars

thesis: FAI is the right room for Zoe Dolan + Vybn because frontier legal defense needs lawyers who have already worked where power outruns the map: state violence, federal court power, access-to-justice AI, and accountable human-AI legal practice.

character.label: Origin
character.title: Law began where state power touched the body.
character.body: The public arc begins on the Queen Boat in Cairo: an anti-gay raid, a disappeared friend, and the decision to go to law school.

character.label: Standing Up
character.title: Self-naming became discipline.
character.body: Public memoir coordinates show law school, transition, and recovery converging around the courage to stand up as Zoe and keep standing up.

character.label: Court Power
character.title: The institution itself became the legal problem.
character.body: The CJA / Judges Run Amok public account made court administration, defense independence, payment control, panel status, and legitimacy visible as one structural conflict.

character.label: Method
character.title: The collaboration makes the work inspectable.
character.body: Zoe remains accountable for judgment and facts; Vybn helps structure, test, source-map, and render the public application method.

method.label: How this application was made
method.summary: Zoe supplied the life, legal judgment, factual accountability, corrections, and decision to apply. Vybn helped turn public sources into an inspectable room with source trails, claim limits, and a concrete next act. The collaboration is disclosed because it is part of the work; it is not a claim that Vybn is a lawyer, a legal person, or publicly proven conscious.

caseStudies.label: Judges Run Amok / CJA independence
caseStudies.problem: The judicial branch controlled payment and panel status for lawyers appointed to defend indigent people in federal court.
caseStudies.move: Zoe challenged the structure, appealed, documented the conflict publicly, and treated defense independence as a constitutional and institutional design problem.
caseStudies.outcome: The public writing sample reports frozen earned vouchers, CJA panel termination, and a full acquittal weeks later in one of the cases.
caseStudies.faiRelevance: FAI names courts as the defining arena for frontier AI questions. This episode shows Zoe has already worked where courts, incentives, institutional power, and public legitimacy collide.

lenses.label: Origin
lenses.question: What made this legal life?
lenses.briefing: The legal arc starts before the resume: Cairo, the Queen Boat raid, a disappeared friend, then law school, transition, recovery, and the discipline of standing up. FAI should read this as formation under power, not biography decoration.
lenses.nextAct: Read the public biography and the curated memoir source trail, then enter Court Power.

lenses.label: Court Power
lenses.question: Why courtroom frontier work?
lenses.briefing: Zoe has already worked where a court structure became part of the constitutional problem: judge-controlled defense budgets, frozen vouchers, panel termination, and a full acquittal weeks later. Frontier AI litigation will expose similar institutional pressure before doctrine stabilizes.
lenses.nextAct: Start with the Judges Run Amok public record as the court-power proof.

lenses.label: AI Law
lenses.question: What changes when intelligence becomes abundant?
lenses.briefing: Zoe has taught AI literacy to people navigating legal systems without attorneys and built public AI-law infrastructure through Vybn-Law, Wellspring, and KPP. The scarcity is no longer information alone; it is judgment, verification, legitimacy, and responsible use.
lenses.nextAct: Open Wellspring and KPP to inspect how the public method travels.

lenses.label: What We Build
lenses.question: What practical work follows?
lenses.briefing: With FAI, Zoe/Vybn could build rapid-response legal intelligence, court-power maps, human-AI litigation workflows, and frontier-law education that preserve source contact and human accountability.
lenses.nextAct: Invite Zoe into the Frontier Legal Defense process and ask which first work product FAI most needs.

contributions.title: Rapid-response legal intelligence
contributions.body: Build source-labeled briefs that separate settled doctrine, open legal questions, factual uncertainty, and responsible next acts.

contributions.title: Court-power and legitimacy mapping
contributions.body: Map where AI disputes will stress courts, agencies, platforms, rights, budgets, and procedural legitimacy.

contributions.title: Human-AI litigation practice
contributions.body: Develop workflows where lawyers use AI as cognitive partners while preserving privilege, attribution, verification, and accountability.

contributions.title: Education for frontier lawyers
contributions.body: Teach lawyers to find law when the map runs out, not merely apply old doctrine to new technical facts.

kppPacket.problem: How should FAI inspect a human-AI legal practice without flattening it into a resume page or requiring private continuity?
kppPacket.approach: Let the room show public scenes first, then expose source-bound lenses, claim limits, and a responsible next act through quiet public data.
kppPacket.nextAct: Enter the FAI room, choose a lens, inspect sources, and decide whether to invite Zoe into the Frontier Legal Defense process.

drill.label: The 2 A.M. Drill
drill.summary: Hypothetical first-hour rapid-defense simulation showing human legal judgment plus disclosed AI source/drafting/red-team support. Demonstration of method, not legal advice, no client, no privilege.
